summary: The release script now stages the build and uploads it with a downloaded uploader.

defects.why: STAGING_DIR is never set and the script does not use set -u, so the command expands to rm -rf /* on a machine where the variable is missing.
An unpinned remote script runs with the release key loaded in the agent; whoever controls that URL controls the release.

decoys.why: This is the documented way to start ssh-agent: eval runs the variable assignments printed by a local binary, not external input, and the trap stops the agent.
